## OpenUtau Mobile 1.0.2

> **Vibe-coded with AI.** The additions in this app (Custom resamplers, Auto pitch, Harmony generator and piano roll video export) were written by [Claude](https://claude.com/claude-code) (Anthropic's AI, Claude Sonnet 5.5), directed by sparky-commits1637. The code has not been hand-reviewed, so please report problems.

### What's new in 1.0.2
- **Piano roll video export:** the beat grid now keeps going for as long as the background music does, instead of disappearing when the vocals end.
- **Piano roll video export:** the final video file is now assembled by writing video and audio together instead of one after the other. This avoids high memory use on long videos.

### Updating
- Signed with the same key as 1.0.0 and 1.0.1, so it installs over them and keeps your data.
- The package name is unchanged, so it still installs separately from the official OpenUtau Mobile. Android **ARM64** only.
